evidenceProblems: main-owned-memory: uncharged main memory in F2 at the loaded checkpoint (0.18 MiB of forced-GC heap above the warmed host is not in the ledger's current 7.76 MiB after excluding 0.4 MiB of measured compiled-code growth and 0 MiB of layout-shift entries; allowance: the warmed host's open gap 0 MiB + independent noise 0 MiB (idle probe 0 MiB, warm-host checkpoint procedure 0 MiB, capped by this checkpoint's spread 0 MiB))

main-owned-memory: uncharged main memory in F2 at the closed checkpoint (0.06 MiB of forced-GC heap above the warmed host is not in the ledger's current 0 MiB after excluding 0.27 MiB of measured compiled-code growth and 0 MiB of layout-shift entries; allowance: the warmed host's open gap 0 MiB + independent noise 0 MiB (idle probe 0 MiB, warm-host checkpoint procedure 0 MiB, capped by this checkpoint's spread 0 MiB))

superseded.note: r13: not admitted; its allowance used the session's own reading spread (codex round 5) and its checkpoints ran beside the harness samplers.
r12: not admitted; per-cell transforms made every cell a paint layer (uncharged ~1.1 KB per cell); fixed in 752ccad.
r11: not admitted; before the viewer stopped shifting layout (its closed residue was the page layout-shift buffer) and before layout-shift entries were measured.
r10: not admitted; before the viewer-representative DOM calibration and per-checkpoint repeated readings (it has no heapReadings).
r9: not admitted under the round-4 gate before compiled-code growth was measured and excluded; it has no code readings.
r8: admitted under the round-3 rules (live peak vs ledger peak only); it has no warm-open record, so it does not validate under the round-4 per-checkpoint gate.

r7: NOT admitted. One forced-GC F2 sample at sort completion was 16.6 MiB above the ledger peak; the gap was the uncharged browser text-shaping cache of retained tile canvases (fixed in fc554a4, measured by r8). Retained as the evidence of that finding.

r6: admitted, but the ledger did not charge the browser text-shaping cache held by tile canvases (about 15 MiB during the F2 scroll), and each worker filter apply re-read its column three times (about 2.8 s end to end). Superseded by r8.

r5: admitted under the round-3 rules, but reply charges ended only on collection (F4 ledger over-counted value-list replies) and the perf page closed with a re-render plus one click to release React-held updates; superseded by r6 (replies settled on adoption, idle close).
r4: admitted under the round-2 evaluator (post-close floor, fixed 2 MiB tolerance, timer-released replies); it has no warmed-host baseline and does not validate under the round-3 rules.
r3: not admitted (no main-owned ledger; main peak pending). It predates the round-2 evidence rules and the ledger, so it does not validate under the current evaluator.
r2 was admitted by the earlier summary-trusting evaluator; it does not validate under the raw-derived evaluator (no content fixture identity, no live heap samples, main-memory peak pending).
r1: input acknowledgment miss (header sort 11,897-13,316 ms).

viewerEvidence.note: S10.2 viewer receipt r14: desktop NOT admitted. Every row passes except main-owned-memory, pending: with independent noise (~0) and quiet, sampler-free checkpoints, F2 loaded keeps 0.18 MiB and F2 closed 0.06 MiB outside the ledger (measured code growth excluded); F4 is fully attributed. The F2 closed residue is attributed to Blink IdToNodeMap and V8 smi-string-cache capacity grown by the harness's own heap snapshots; the loaded remainder is not attributed. Left pending.
